body.summary: Implement shared staging for the normal @insrc/project-memory tarball. Verify upstream LanceDB 0.40.0 integrity, narrow only the optional provider entries, retain licenses and native binding versions, and have packed consumer tests use this same artifact.
acceptanceChecks: Verify the staged SDK's upstream SHA-512, unchanged code and types, retained license and notices, and removal of only the approved optional provider entries.

Check actual tarball contents and a clean default consumer graph. The SDK is bundled, native bindings resolve from their pinned optional packages, and staging files, affected embedding paths and host overrides are absent.
